title: SockSwap
tagline: sock swap lets you tokenize or categorize socks you spot​​​​​
description:
this project combines an erc 6909 with reality.eth into a sort of game / experiment
i have a box for socks. you are only supposed to put unworn (complete) pairs of socks in that have been registered. that way you know which id you want to mint. the flip side is being able to redeem. tokenizing your socks is optional, if you're the first to spot them you can simply categorize them.  the rules are upgradeable by the deployer in case you deploy and want to keep iterating over the course of the hackathon
how_its_made:
forge/foundry + solady
i wanted to go on scroll testnet but unfortunately i didnt check closely enough
the existing reality.eth sepolia scroll was their alpha testnet so is gone now :(
